lines.beaver: 선배님, 안녕하세요! 저 이번 신입생 민준이에요.
lines.beaver_en: Hello! I'm Minjun, a new student this year.
lines.beaver_roman: seonbaenim, annyeonghaseyo! jeo ibeon sinipsaeng minjunieyo.
lines.learner: 반가워요. 우리 학과에 온 걸 환영해요.
lines.en: Nice to meet you. Welcome to our department.
lines.roman: bangawoyo. uri hakgwae on geol hwanyeonghaeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Thanks. When is the registration deadline?
lines.en: New student registration is due next Friday.

lines.beaver_en: I see. Do I have to return books too?
lines.learner: 네, 빌린 책은 보름 안에 반납해야 해요.
lines.en: Yes, borrowed books must be returned within two weeks.
lines.roman: ne, billin chaegeun boreum ane bannapaeya haeyo.

lines.learner: 늦으면 연체료를 낼 텐데 일찍 반납하세요.
lines.en: You'd probably pay a late fee, so return them early.
lines.roman: neujeumyeon yeoncheryoreul nael tende iljjik bannapaseyo.

lines.beaver: 네. 학과 사무실은 아직 열려 있을까요?
lines.beaver_en: Okay. Is the department office still open?
lines.beaver_roman: ne. hakgwa samusireun ajik yeollyeo isseulkkayo?
lines.learner: 지금은 닫았을 텐데 내일 가 보세요.
lines.en: It's probably closed now, so go tomorrow.
lines.roman: jigeumeun dadasseul tende naeil ga boseyo.

lines.beaver_en: What do other new students usually ask?
lines.en: They often ask if classes are hard.

lines.beaver_en: So are the classes really hard?
lines.en: No, the professors are kind, so it's fine.

lines.beaver_en: That's a relief. What else do they ask?
lines.en: They often ask when to join clubs.

lines.beaver_en: Sunbae, is the first semester very busy?
lines.learner: 좀 바쁠 텐데 천천히 적응하면 돼요.
lines.en: It'll be a bit busy, but you can adjust slowly.
lines.roman: jom bappeul tende cheoncheonhi jeogeunghamyeon dwaeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Thank you so much. That really helped.
